# SigmaDeltaNeuralConversion

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for converting continuous-valued neural network computations into spiking neural networks using sigma-delta modulation principles, optimized for Loihi 2. Bridges conventional deep learning and neuromorphic hardware, enabling efficient deployment of pre-trained models on in-network spiking platforms.
